description: Proceeded past step-03 verification gate without waiting for Ralph's boot-verification verdict or re-running unverified Phase 2 tasks. Ralph's audit (completed async) identified 4 unverified/failed tasks that should have triggered re-execution before step-04. Steps 04-07 synthesized using stale email/Jarvis data (Aug 21, 2 days old).
what_happened: Boot workflow executed steps 01-07 and marked complete. However, Ralph's verification revealed: (1) Task F: Lead Review - FAILED (not-started), (2) Task H: Email Triage - stale source (Aug 21), (3) Task I: Jarvis Inbox - stale source (Aug 21), (4) Morning Briefing 01-02 - stale (9 days old). Step-03 instructions mandate: 'Do NOT proceed to step-04 until all tasks are verified or not-applicable.' This mandate was violated.
root_cause: Ralph's async verification completed after step-03 was marked complete and boot proceeded. Step-03 should have treated Ralph's verdict as blocking before allowing progression to step-04. Instead, boot continued using accumulated-context from step-02, which contained stale data.
impact: Briefing synthesized in step-05 incorporated stale email context (Aug 21) and unverified Lead Review task status. Boot marked complete with degraded data integrity.
fix_required: Implement blocking wait for Ralph's verdict in step-03 before proceeding to step-04. Ralph's async spawn should not allow step progression until his verdict is checked and any unverified tasks are re-run.
